name: Return the Comb
label: Quest
description: Madame Eva waits in Darkshire for the comb Blind Mary has returned. Its ghostly strands can be spun into Ghost Hair Thread.

clips.title: The story
paras: Madame Eva waits in Darkshire for the comb Blind Mary has returned. Its ghostly strands can be spun into Ghost Hair Thread.

Blind Mary waits in a shack south of Darkshire, mourning her death and the change it brought. Madame Eva’s comb reminds her of mortal grooming, and deepens her sorrow. She sees only an apparition, a monster stripped of mortal grace, certain no one can love her again. In horror, she thrusts the comb and the ghostly hair tangled in its teeth back into your hands.

Madame Eva awaits the comb in Darkshire, knowing the task was grim. The ghostly hair gives the fortune teller what she needs to spin a spool of Ghost Hair Thread. She pays you for any strands left over after the delicate work.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take it, take this comb away from me!
I'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary. You have my Comb...?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare. Here are some coins for those extra strands.
